description: couchbase-cli-setting-encryption.md's own SYNOPSIS line begins '_couchbase-cli setting-enable_ ...' - naming a different command (setting-enable) than the page's own title and every EXAMPLE (setting-encryption). Separately, SYNOPSIS and EXAMPLES both use --rotate-key <keyid> for key rotation, but OPTIONS defines the flag as '--rotate <keyid>' (confirmed: grep of the page shows both '--rotate-key' at lines 23/57/309 and '--rotate <keyid>' at line 246, never reconciled to one spelling).
